question: Can the current final-MLP adapter distinguish all 20 paired decision states when only these states receive training updates?

design.source: JVPR first-divergent positions from the unchanged 64-row corpus
design.objective: equal full-vocabulary CE at the 40 positions

measurements: target-minus-alternative margin by row and class
full-answer teacher-forced metrics on all 64 rows as a separate readout
checkpoint_selection: Among saved steps 25/50/100, maximize complete decision pairs, then total correct decision targets, then earlier step; choose before generated-response inspection.
comparison_logic: This isolates the decision subtask from the other 2,319 token losses. The following comparison can add a jointly trained output head while reusing the same frozen post-attention states.

joint_adapter_followup.implementation: Add the head LoRA delta to the live post-RMSNorm y projection in mlp_forward; preserve gradients through MLP and norm. Existing native operators and separate merge exporters suffice.
